objective: Produce source-qualified PEAD event inputs without allowing one source family to supply market evidence, consensus expectations, and announcement truth.

permitted_roles: dated market capitalization and size slices
corporate-action and terminal-return accounting only after field semantics and completeness are independently proved
fail_closed_rules: SF1 datekey is filing visibility and may not be relabeled as earnings-announcement time
unproved cash-distribution or terminal-settlement semantics block executable return qualification
missing lifecycle or delisting evidence excludes the affected path

minimum_evidence: stable provider observation identity
issuer/security and fiscal-period identity
consensus metric and per-share basis
consensus value and currency
analyst count
provider observation/effective timestamp with precision
trusted acquisition timestamp
preserved raw receipt and provider-specific row reference
consensus.selection_rule: Select only a source vintage proved strictly earlier than independently established announcement availability; same-date observations without sufficient intraday precision are ineligible.
consensus.independence_rule: Provider actuals and announcement times are cross-checks only and cannot satisfy pead_announcement_evidence.v1.

minimum_evidence: issuer identity including CIK when available
fiscal period identity
reported actual value, metric, basis, unit, and currency
preserved source document bytes and content digest
source URL or SEC accession identity
retrieval timestamp
issuer publication/distribution timestamp and precision when available
SEC acceptance timestamp retained as a distinct field when applicable
deterministic extraction method and reviewer disposition
announcement.time_rule: SEC acceptance is filing provenance and is not silently equated with exact first-public issuer-release availability.
announcement.ambiguity_policy: Missing, conflicting, or insufficiently precise actual/timing evidence excludes the event unless the inherited protocol has a precommitted conservative visibility rule.
announcement.independence_rule: Consensus-provider values may be compared but cannot populate required issuer/SEC actual or timing fields.

minimum_evidence: canonical credential-free SF1, SEP, and TICKERS export requests
provider data snapshot and last-refreshed timestamps
preserved content-addressed raw ZIP and CSV members
exact provider and converted schemas, row counts, and byte digests
independently replayed CSV-to-Parquet row-multiset equivalence

security_identity_snapshot.ambiguity_policy: Missing, duplicate, overlapping, or contradictory identity intervals block the affected census row.

required_scope_proof: coverage of inactive and delisted securities
source-census, enumerated-event, and identity-gap counts with an exact reconciliation
required_event_fields: canonical event key and event digest
event_manifest.identity_binding_rule: Security, permaticker, and dated ticker identity are supplied by the separately content-addressed identity snapshot bound in the manifest; they are not copied into or inferred from the event key.
event_manifest.cardinality_rule: Every ex-ante expected event appears exactly once; evidence availability and signal outcome may not alter this set.

required_outputs: one disposition for every event-manifest row
both source values for every compared field
period, basis, currency, share-basis, and timestamp reconciliation decisions

required_inputs: official SEP close and closeunadj field-semantics evidence
required_outputs: one disposition for every event-manifest row including upstream exclusions
exact dated identity and lifecycle record
latest positive observed session close strictly before independent first-public time
split-normalized close, contemporaneous closeunadj, normalization factor, and source-row digest
source snapshot, identity, calendar, semantics, and upstream reconciliation digests

required_inputs: provider-adapter replay of every selected consensus value, count, metric, timestamp, and raw-response membership
exact candidate specification, consensus source manifest, and construction-code bytes matching their bound digests
required_outputs: one final accepted or excluded disposition for every frozen event
exact cross-artifact identity and share-basis reconciliation
actual, consensus, analyst count, first-public time, and strictly prior denominator
all upstream artifact identities and replay-verifier code identities

cross_lane_gates: all artifact schemas and content digests verify before semantic validation
event identities and fiscal periods match without ticker-only joins
consensus vintage precedes announcement availability at the available timestamp precision
actual and consensus metric, unit, per-share basis, currency, and split treatment reconcile
announcement actual and availability have independent SEC/issuer evidence
the final signal-input receipt proves that the signal denominator market close is strictly before announcement availability
every event-manifest row receives exactly one accepted or excluded disposition
enumerated event counts exactly reconcile to the frozen universe census

immutability.canonical_serialization: UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted object keys and no insignificant whitespace
immutability.artifact_identity: SHA-256 of canonical payload or preserved raw bytes as declared by the producing schema
immutability.rule_change_policy: Any source, universe, timing, signal, or statistical-family rule change requires a new versioned package.
